 operator  repo  tasks 11:  prog 1  review 1  blocked 3  todo 2  flows 5 ⚠4  pod ●3              2s  13:41:00
 help ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 1 2 3 4         the pane with the table: tasks, flows, pod, reactor
 ↑ ↓  j k        move
 pgup pgdn  g G  page, first, last
 enter           open: the task, the workspace or the event full width, or the flow's trace (flow trace <id>)
 p               show or hide the task pane
 tab             focus the task pane, to scroll it
 d               in flows: choose what the table lists - the stuck report, or one definition's flows
 esc             back, or clear the filter
 b               every status ↔ the active ones (in-progress, in-review, blocked, todo)
 S               sort tasks: pick-up, age, slug, territory
 /               filter the pane as you type
 + -             the tracker's refresh interval
 r               reload now
 ?               this help
 q               quit

 where the numbers come from
 tracker         /repo/tasks
 map             /repo/architecture.yaml
 project         /repo
 routes to       architect territories --json · architect check --format json, when the map's mtime moves
 blocker         the first `Blocked by [slug](slug.md)` in the body, and that task's status
 flows           flow definitions --json · flow list --json · flow stuck --json, every 5s
 pod             pod status --json · pod list --json when it is up, every 5s
 reactor         reactor status --json · reactor events --since 1h --json, every 5s
 interval        2s for the tracker
